relations.subject: Françoise Robin
relations.object: National Institute of Oriental Languages and Civilizations (INALCO)
relations.evidence: Françoise Robin (born 1968) is a Tibetan-studies professor at Paris' National Institute of Oriental Languages and Civilizations (INALCO)

relations.subject: Françoise Robin
relations.evidence: In 1999 she obtained her DEA from INALCO.

relations.subject: Françoise Robin
relations.evidence: Her doctoral thesis, submitted in 2003, was supervised by Heather Stoddard and was entitled: La littérature de fiction d'expression tibétaine au Tibet depuis 1950 : enjeux identitaires

relations.subject: Françoise Robin
relations.evidence: Subsequently, Robin became a professor at INALCO.

relations.subject: Françoise Robin
relations.object: Institute of Tibetan Studies of the Collège de France
relations.evidence: From 2009 to 2015, she was director of the Institute of Tibetan Studies of the Collège de France.

relations.subject: Françoise Robin
relations.evidence: She has directed the Tibetan division of INALCO since 2011

relations.subject: Françoise Robin
relations.role: director of their Department of Southeast Asia, Upper Asia, and the Pacific
relations.evidence: was director of their Department of Southeast Asia, Upper Asia, and the Pacific from 2013 to 2014.

relations.subject: Françoise Robin
relations.object: SFEMT (The French Society for Study of the Tibetan World)
relations.evidence: She was co-founder of SFEMT (The French Society for Study of the Tibetan World) in 2012

relations.subject: Françoise Robin
relations.object: Research Centre for East Asian Civilizations (CRCAO)
relations.evidence: She is an associate member of the Research Centre for East Asian Civilizations (CRCAO) at the French National Centre for Scientific Research.

relations.subject: Françoise Robin
relations.evidence: 2007 « Réduplication dans les langues tibéto-birmanes : l'exemple du birman et du tibétain », jointly with A. Vittrant, first author

relations.subject: Françoise Robin
relations.evidence: 2006 Le Grand livre des proverbes tibétains, recueil thématique de proverbes bilingues tibétain-français, précédés d'une introduction et suivis d'un index, jointly with N. Tournadre.
